# Project list sets

<!-- Generated by ProjectsSite/tools/build_skill.py from the solutions' list schemas. Don't edit by hand. -->

Three sets of lists can go on the projects site. `scripts/Provision-ProjectLists.ps1 -Sets` takes any of them.

| Set | Lists | For | Used by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pmo` | 10 | Workstreams, Master RAID Log, Action and Decision Tracker, Change Requests, governance calendar, document libraries and the PMO flows' audit lists. | Enterprise PMO flows 01-05 and the Portfolio-Governance-Hub page. |
| `controlcentre` | 6 | SP_ lists behind the Project Control Centre pages: migration register, page delivery, actions, RAID, decisions, project updates. | The four Control Centre pages (List and Quick Chart web parts) and the Control Centre Power App. |
| `board` | 5 | Programme Status, Board Decisions, Programme RAID, Migration Waves and Programme Gates for the Project Management Control Board portal. | PortalSnapshots flow P2, which republishes the Control Board page from them. |

## Overlapping lists

These do the same job in different sets. Choose one per role where you can; if you create more than one, say which is the master.

| Role | `pmo` | `controlcentre` | `board` |
|---|---|---|---|
| RAID log | Master RAID Log | SP_RAID | Programme RAID |
| Decisions | Action and Decision Tracker | SP_Decisions | Board Decisions |
| Actions | Action and Decision Tracker | SP_Actions | - |

## `pmo`: Enterprise PMO hub

Workstreams, Master RAID Log, Action and Decision Tracker, Change Requests, governance calendar, document libraries and the PMO flows' audit lists.

**Used by:** Enterprise PMO flows 01-05 and the Portfolio-Governance-Hub page.

**After creating the lists:**

- Run EnterprisePMO/provisioning/Provision-PMOHub.ps1 on the same site for the views, RAG/due-date formatting, hub page and HTML pages (it skips lists that already exist).
- Import the EnterprisePMO solution and set PMOSiteUrl to this site.

### PMO Workstreams

One row per portfolio workstream. Every RAID item, action, change request and document points at one. Flow 02 loops over the active rows. The RAG columns feed the Power BI scorecard.

| Column (internal name) | Type | Required | Choices / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Workstream code (`WorkstreamCode`) | text | yes | Short code used in snapshot keys, e.g. ALPHA. Unique. |
| Sponsor (`Sponsor`) | person |  |  |
| Workstream lead (`WorkstreamLead`) | person |  |  |
| Active (`Active`) | yes/no |  | Only active workstreams get weekly snapshots and early warnings. |
| Overall RAG (`OverallRAG`) | choice |  | Red, Amber, Green |
| Schedule RAG (`ScheduleRAG`) | choice |  | Red, Amber, Green |
| Budget RAG (`BudgetRAG`) | choice |  | Red, Amber, Green |
| Scope RAG (`ScopeRAG`) | choice |  | Red, Amber, Green |
| Status summary (`StatusSummary`) | multi-line text |  |  |

### Master RAID Log

Risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies for every workstream. Items flagged Escalated to Executive Board show on the hub and in the daily digest when overdue.

| Column (internal name) | Type | Required | Choices / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Type (`RAIDType`) | choice | yes | Risk, Assumption, Issue, Dependency |
| Workstream (`Workstream`) | lookup to PMO Workstreams | yes |  |
| Description (`Description`) | multi-line text |  |  |
| RAG rating (`RAGRating`) | choice |  | Red, Amber, Green |
| Owner (`Owner`) | person |  |  |
| Status (`Status`) | choice | yes | Open, In progress, Closed |
| Escalated to Executive Board (`EscalatedToExecutiveBoard`) | yes/no |  | Written by a flow; hidden from forms. Set by flow 05 when the Head of PMO approves an escalation request. Not on the forms; the PMO can still set it in grid view for an escalation agreed outside the flow. |
| Request Executive Board escalation (`EscalationRequested`) | yes/no |  | Tick to ask the Head of PMO to put this item in front of the Executive Board (flow 05). Cleared again if the request is declined or not decided, so it can be ticked again. |
| Why it needs the Board (`EscalationJustification`) | multi-line text |  | What the Board must decide or unblock, and by when. Shown in the approval request. |
| Escalation status (`EscalationStatus`) | choice |  | Written by a flow; hidden from forms. Not requested, Requested, Approved, Declined, Not decided |
| Escalation decision (`EscalationDecisionNote`) | multi-line text |  | Written by a flow; hidden from forms. Written by flow 05: who decided, when, and their comments. |
| Target resolution date (`TargetResolutionDate`) | date/time |  |  |
| Mitigation / resolution plan (`Mitigation`) | multi-line text |  |  |
| Closed on (`ClosedDate`) | date/time |  | Written by a flow; hidden from forms. Written by the churn tracker flow when Status changes to Closed. Flow 02 counts closures from it. |
| Date pushes (`DatePushCount`) | number |  | Written by a flow; hidden from forms. Written by the churn tracker flow: how many times TargetResolutionDate has been moved later. Never reset. |
| Original baseline date (`OriginalTargetDate`) | date/time |  | Written by a flow; hidden from forms. Written by the churn tracker flow: the first TargetResolutionDate the item ever had. Users can't see it on the forms; the Date Push Log is the audit trail if it is edited in the grid. |
| Last date push (`LastPushNote`) | multi-line text |  | Written by a flow; hidden from forms. Written by the churn tracker flow: old date, new date, days moved, who and when. |
| Tracked date (flow) (`TrackedDueDate`) | text |  | Written by a flow; hidden from forms. Flow-only. The TargetResolutionDate value the churn tracker last saw, as raw text ('none' when empty). The trigger condition compares it with TargetResolutionDate, which stops the flow re-triggering on its own update. Leave blank when loading. |
| Tracked status (flow) (`TrackedStatus`) | text |  | Written by a flow; hidden from forms. Flow-only. The Status the churn tracker last saw. Leave blank when loading. |

The trigger condition compares it with DueDate, which stops the flow re-triggering on its own update. Leave blank when loading. |

### Change Requests

Baseline change control: scope, budget or timeline variance requests. Target of the hub's Submit Change Request link. Flow 04 runs the PMO review and, over tolerance, the Steering Committee decision.

| Column (internal name) | Type | Required | Choices / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| CR reference (`CRReference`) | text |  | Written by a flow; hidden from forms. Allocated by flow 04 as CR-nnn from the item ID when left blank. |
| Workstream (`Workstream`) | lookup to PMO Workstreams | yes |  |
| Change type (`ChangeType`) | choice | yes | Scope, Budget, Timeline, Multiple |
| Change requested (`Description`) | multi-line text | yes |  |
| Justification (`Justification`) | multi-line text | yes |  |
| Impact on baseline (`ImpactSummary`) | multi-line text |  |  |
| Budget impact (GBP) (`BudgetImpact`) | number |  | Net change to the approved budget; negative for a saving. Over CRBudgetTolerance goes to the Steering Committee. |
| Schedule impact (days) (`ScheduleImpactDays`) | number |  | Days the baseline end date moves. Over CRScheduleToleranceDays goes to the Steering Committee. |
| Requested by (`RequestedBy`) | person |  | Who gets the outcome email. Blank means the person who created the item. |
| Status (`Status`) | choice | yes | Submitted, Under review - PMO, Under review - Steering Committee, Approved, Rejected, Returned to requester, Decision overdue, Withdrawn |
| Steering Committee date (`SteeringCommitteeDate`) | date/time |  |  |
| Decision route (`DecisionRoute`) | text |  | Written by a flow; hidden from forms. Written by flow 04: PMO (within tolerance) or Steering Committee. |
| Decided by (`DecidedBy`) | text |  | Written by a flow; hidden from forms. |
| Decision date (`DecisionDate`) | date/time |  | Written by a flow; hidden from forms. |
| Decision note (`DecisionNote`) | multi-line text |  | Written by a flow; hidden from forms. Written by flow 04: approvers' comments at each stage. |

### PMO Date Push Log

Written by flows 03a and 03b only: one row each time a RAID target date or action due date is moved later. Append-only audit trail; flow 02 reads it for churn.

| Source list (`SourceList`) | choice | yes | Master RAID Log, Action and Decision Tracker |
| Source item ID (`SourceItemId`) | number | yes |  |
| Workstream (`Workstream`) | lookup to PMO Workstreams |  |  |
| Previous date (`PreviousDate`) | date/time |  |  |
| New date (`NewDate`) | date/time |  |  |
| Days pushed (`DaysPushed`) | number |  |  |
| Pushed by (`PushedBy`) | text |  |  |
| Pushes of this item in window (`PushesInWindow`) | number |  | This push plus the item's earlier pushes in the last ChurnWindowDays (default 14). Flow 02 raises CHURN-CRIT when it reaches ChurnThreshold. |

### PMO Digest History

Written by flow 01 only: one row per daily digest (Title digest|yyyy-MM-dd). The row is claimed before posting so a re-run the same day posts nothing. Delete a Failed row to let a re-run post.

| Column (internal name) | Type | Required | Choices / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Digest date (`DigestDate`) | date/time | yes |  |
| Status (`Status`) | choice | yes | Posting, Posted, Failed |
| Overdue escalations (`EscalationsCount`) | number |  |  |
| Overdue board actions (`ActionsCount`) | number |  |  |
| Flow run ID (`FlowRunId`) | text |  |  |

## `controlcentre`: Project Control Centre

SP_ lists behind the Project Control Centre pages: migration register, page delivery, actions, RAID, decisions, project updates.

**Used by:** The four Control Centre pages (List and Quick Chart web parts) and the Control Centre Power App.

**After creating the lists:**

- Apply SharePointControlCentre/sharepoint/column-formatting/DeliveryStatus.json to SP_PageDelivery's Delivery Status column.
- Build the four pages per SharePointControlCentre/diagrams/page-layout.md.

## `board`: Control Board lists (portal flow P2)

Programme Status, Board Decisions, Programme RAID, Migration Waves and Programme Gates for the Project Management Control Board portal.

**Used by:** PortalSnapshots flow P2, which republishes the Control Board page from them.

**After creating the lists:**

- Set PortalBoardSiteUrl in the PortalSnapshots solution to this site.
- Add one Programme Status row before P2's first run.

### Programme Status

One row per reporting date with the headline figures. Flow P2 uses the latest row for the Control Board KPIs; RAID counts come from Programme RAID.

| Column (internal name) | Type | Required | Choices / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Report date (`ReportDate`) | date/time | yes |  |
| Overall RAG (`OverallRAG`) | choice | yes | Red, Amber, Green |
| Sites completed (`SitesDone`) | number |  |  |
| Sites in scope (`SitesTotal`) | number |  |  |
| Data migrated (GB) (`GBDone`) | number |  |  |
| Data in scope (GB) (`GBTotal`) | number |  |  |
| Open actions (`OpenActions`) | number |  |  |

### Board Decisions

Decisions for the Control Board with options and the pre-written minute. Flow P2 publishes them, highest criticality score first.

| Column (internal name) | Type | Required | Choices / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Decision ref (`DecisionRef`) | text | yes | e.g. D-52. |
| Category (`Category`) | text |  | e.g. Cat A (Go-Live Critical). |
| Criticality score (`DecisionScore`) | number |  | 0 to 100. |
| Owner (`Owner`) | text |  |  |
| Decision due (`DueDate`) | date/time |  |  |
| Status (`Status`) | choice | yes | Required, Approved, Deferred, Rejected |
| Linked RAID (`LinkedRAID`) | text |  |  |
| Option A (recommended) (`OptionA`) | multi-line text |  |  |
| Option B (`OptionB`) | multi-line text |  |  |
| Option C (`OptionC`) | multi-line text |  |  |
| Recommended option (`Recommended`) | text |  |  |
| Rationale (`Rationale`) | multi-line text |  |  |
| Cost of delay (`CostOfDelay`) | multi-line text |  |  |
| Board minute statement (`BoardStatement`) | multi-line text |  |  |
